mechanism: Ciprofloxacin can cause QT prolongation and cardiac arrhythmias, which are exacerbated by hyperkalemia; potassium supplementation or high dietary intake increases risk of elevated serum potassium levels especially in patients with renal impairment.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels and ECG in patients requiring both agents, particularly those with renal dysfunction or taking other potassium-elevating medications; adjust potassium supplementation as needed.
